text: Committee members will discuss the City of Toronto's Multilingual Information Provisions Policy with respect to the French language.

The French Language Advisory Committee recommends that: 1. The City Manager review the existing Multilingual Information Provisions Policy to determine whether the inclusion of French in City services is adequately addressed, and if not, to make recommendations to the Executive Committee at its meeting on April 17, 2018 on changes that may be required. 2. The City Manager consult with the City’s Council Advisory Bodies in any future review of the City of Toronto's Multilingual Information Provisions Policy.
